candidate_scope: Party mentions whose legal_suffix_name_key has more than one conservative source-name form.

evidence_statuses.corroborated_candidate: At least one non-empty location key occurs under two or more distinct observed name forms.
evidence_statuses.partial_context: Some name forms have location evidence and others do not, with no shared location across forms.
evidence_statuses.divergent_location_context: Every name form has location evidence, but no location is shared across distinct forms.
evidence_statuses.name_only: The group has no location evidence.

policy.warning: A shared address is supporting evidence, not proof of common legal identity; divergent addresses can represent branches rather than different entities.

all_conditions_required: every observed name form has location evidence
the group has exactly one normalized location
the group has at most one non-empty organization context
the group does not mix supplier and public-body role families
provisional_promotion.alias_membership_condition: The individual party mention must carry the group's corroborating location.
excluded_from_v1: groups with multiple non-empty organization contexts
provisional_promotion.publication_policy: Provisional canonical IDs are analytical identifiers and must not be published as official organization identifiers.
